prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only `application/json` (without also requiring `text/event-stream`), even though JSON response mode never opens an SSE stream. prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both touch the exact same validation block (~line 598-610 of webStandardStreamableHttp.ts) and fix the identical spec-compliance gap. #1996 replaces the ad-hoc string check with a dedicated `acceptsMediaType()` helper that does real HTTP Accept-header parsing: it splits on commas, trims each media-range, parses `;`-separated parameters, and explicitly excludes entries with `q=0` before matching type/subtype. #2046's diff shows it keeps the ad-hoc approach, deriving `acceptsJson` from `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` — a plain substring check that would also match unrelated types sharing that substring (e.g. `application/json-patch+json`) and does not honor a client explicitly de-prioritizing JSON via `q=0`. #1996's parser-based fix covers strictly more of the Accept-header edge cases visible in the two diffs.

clusters.pick_reason: Both touch the exact same validation block (~line 598-610 of webStandardStreamableHttp.ts) and fix the identical spec-compliance gap. #1996 replaces the ad-hoc string check with a dedicated `acceptsMediaType()` helper that does real HTTP Accept-header parsing: it splits on commas, trims each media-range, parses `;`-separated parameters, and explicitly excludes entries with `q=0` before matching type/subtype. #2046's diff shows it keeps the ad-hoc approach, deriving `acceptsJson` from `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` — a plain substring check that would also match unrelated types sharing that substring (e.g. `application/json-patch+json`) and does not honor a client explicitly de-prioritizing JSON via `q=0`. #1996's parser-based fix covers strictly more of the Accept-header edge cases visible in the two diffs.

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs replace the single slice(0,-1) trailing-slash strip with a regex that strips all trailing slashes, fixing the same buildWellKnownPath bug. #2215 goes further: it factors the fix into a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper reused across call sites, and also updates shouldAttemptFallback()'s root check from pathname === '/' to pathname === '' to match the new normalized (empty-string) representation of root - a check #2214 leaves stale/inconsistent since it never touches shouldAttemptFallback. #2214 only patches buildWellKnownPath/buildDiscoveryUrls in isolation, so merging it alone would still leave the root-fallback logic broken.
